description: Southern Provincial Council - Daycare Center Draft Statute of Southern Province - 2019
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a draft statute ("Daycare Centre Draft Statute") that establishes a regulatory framework for the registration, supervision, and administration of daycare centers in the Southern Province. It outlines the legal provisions, establishment of a governing board, and regulatory requirements, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) for new regulations and statutory instruments.
